_doc: WS-C (D-6) externalized classification vocabulary for the discovery + ingest path. Every list here is matched against TITLE or BODY text (not against a section-role identifier), so no MediaWiki category/infobox/section structural signal exists at the decision point. Where a section role IS available the code uses it as the primary structural classifier; these are the irreducible text/title fallbacks. Each entry passed the D-6 gate: (1) no category/infobox/section signal at the decision point, (2) no viable statistical signal (short titles / fixed vocab), (3) externalized (this file), (4) justified with a pilot-bias note below. Section-role taxonomy lists (which ARE the structural signal) are intentionally NOT here — they remain in code as structural infra.

faction_title_tokens._why_no_structural_signal: Faction pages are not reliably grouped under a dedicated zone-page section; the only pre-fetch signal is a faction-ish token in the link title. (Post-fetch, the page's MediaWiki categories settle it, but typing happens before traversal.)
faction_title_tokens._pilot_bias_note: Tuned against WPL (Scarlet Crusade, Argent Dawn, Forsaken). Generalizes via generic organization words (order, covenant, tribe, cult, circle) rather than named factions.

event_title_tokens._why_no_structural_signal: Historical events rarely have their own zone-page section and are not a MediaWiki entity kind in the registry; the link title is the only pre-fetch cue.
event_title_tokens._pilot_bias_note: Generic conflict vocabulary (war/battle/invasion); 'scourging'/'cataclysm' are WoW-era nouns but apply across zones.

character_role_hints._why_no_structural_signal: A link in a non-character section may still point to a person; with no fetched infobox/category at decision time, an honorific/title token in the name is the only pre-fetch cue beyond the two-title-case-words heuristic. Section role 'notable_characters' is now the primary structural signal in code; these hints only apply when the section role is uninformative.
character_role_hints._pilot_bias_note: Common WoW honorifics; broadly applicable but English-only. Statistical detection is infeasible on a 2-3 token name.

non_location_title_tokens._why_no_structural_signal: Rejects non-place link targets (media/meta/out-of-game) that slipped past section routing; evaluated on the link title before fetch, so no category signal exists yet.
non_location_title_tokens._pilot_bias_note: Out-of-game media markers (novel/novella/short stories/rpg) and meta kinds (class/mob/faction); generic, not zone-specific.

location_hard_reject_tokens._why_no_structural_signal: Hard-rejects location candidates by name (undisplayed/meta/out-of-game) during scoring, before the candidate page is fetched, so no MediaWiki category is available. ('removed'/'warcraft iii' overlap S3's retail filter, which is the authoritative post-fetch category signal in pipeline/common/retail.py; this name-level pass is the pre-fetch backstop.)

location_rpg_tokens._why_no_structural_signal: Down-weights location candidates whose name marks them as RPG/novel/Classic-sourced; scored on the name pre-fetch, so no category exists yet.
location_rpg_tokens._pilot_bias_note: Out-of-game/non-retail source markers; generic. Authoritative retail filtering remains S3's category check.

lore_faction_tokens._why_no_structural_signal: lore_sources excludes obvious character/faction links from the cross-page narrative-lore candidate set, judged on the link title before fetch. Kept distinct from faction_title_tokens (different consumer, narrower set) until a live golden run can prove a single reconciled list is safe.
lore_faction_tokens._pilot_bias_note: Org words plus two named WoW factions (the burning legion, scourge) that recur as lore-page links; reconcile with faction_title_tokens under the WS-C live golden gate.

lore_character_role_hints._why_no_structural_signal: Same pre-fetch link-title judgement as character_role_hints, for the lore-candidate consumer. Kept distinct (adds prince/princess/baron/baroness, drops master) until a live golden run can prove a reconciled list is safe.
lore_character_role_hints._pilot_bias_note: Common WoW honorifics; English-only; reconcile with character_role_hints under the WS-C live golden gate.

entity_typing_race_species_denylist._why_no_structural_signal: should_reject_location_title rejects a link whose title IS a playable race/species name; judged on the title before fetch, so no infobox/category exists yet.
entity_typing_race_species_denylist._pilot_bias_note: Closed set of WoW playable races plus 'gnoll'/'undead'; cross-zone, not WPL-specific.

entity_typing_meta_page_denylist._why_no_structural_signal: Rejects MediaWiki meta/namespace concept pages by exact title (faction/category/world/class/...); evaluated on the title pre-fetch.

entity_typing_location_meta_titles._why_no_structural_signal: Exact-title meta pages that masquerade as locations ('Lore', 'ADP'); title-only judgement pre-fetch.

entity_typing_faction_as_location_denyli._why_no_structural_signal: Rejects faction names that appear as location links; the target page is not fetched, so its faction category is unavailable at decision time.
entity_typing_faction_as_location_denyli._pilot_bias_note: Includes WPL-relevant factions (Argent Dawn, Scourge, Cult of the Damned) plus the global Alliance/Horde/Forsaken; the WPL-specific ones are flagged for the cross-zone smoke test.

quest_alliance_binding_tokens._why_no_structural_signal: Faction binding is read from Questbox wikitext (reputation org / category text), which is free text with no section-role/category signal.

quest_horde_binding_tokens._why_no_structural_signal: Faction binding is read from Questbox wikitext, free text with no structural signal.
quest_horde_binding_tokens._pilot_bias_note: Horde plus its capital/race org names (Undercity, Orgrimmar, Silvermoon, ...); cross-zone WoW vocabulary, not WPL-specific.

entry_quest_title_keywords._why_no_structural_signal: Chain heads are computed structurally (indegree 0); this list only PREFERS the player-facing breadcrumb quest among heads, judged on the quest title. No structural signal distinguishes a breadcrumb from another head.
entry_quest_title_keywords._pilot_bias_note: MIXED: "hero's call"/"warchief's command" are the universal Alliance/Horde zone-breadcrumb quests (cross-zone); "new era for the plaguelands"/"audience with the highlord" are WPL-specific and MUST be revisited for the cross-zone smoke test (likely move to per-zone config or derive from breadcrumb structure in S5).

non_canon_body_markers._why_no_structural_signal: Detects non-canon/RPG history snippets from the snippet BODY text; snippets carry no MediaWiki category.

generic_non_person_words._why_no_structural_signal: _looks_like_person rejects a narrative-link title that is a common noun / race / creature type rather than a named NPC; judged on the title text. (entry_kinds/registry handles known places; this catches generic nouns the registry doesn't list.)
generic_non_person_words._pilot_bias_note: Generic common nouns, races, and creature types; cross-zone. Overlaps entity_typing_race_species_denylist (different consumer) by design.

boss_reject_section_titles._why_no_structural_signal: should_reject_boss_title drops candidate titles that are actually section/meta headers (Loot, Strategy, Gallery, ...) leaking in as links; judged on the title text.
boss_reject_section_titles._pilot_bias_note: Generic wiki section/meta header names; cross-zone.

non_character_titles._why_no_structural_signal: Title-matched denylist for game/meta pages and generic creature-class nouns the sparse registry does not classify; judged on the title text from narrative/history link mining.
non_character_titles._pilot_bias_note: Universal WoW terms (Lich, Necromancer, Ghoul, ...); not zone/instance specific.

non_person_narrative_titles._why_no_structural_signal: Multi-word capitalized titles that are factions/forces/concepts, not individual characters; judged on the title text (the registry does not enumerate every faction).
non_person_narrative_titles._pilot_bias_note: Cross-WoW factions/forces/dragonflights plus a few WPL-relevant ones (Scarlet Crusade, Cult of the Damned); the named-faction set is broad but cross-zone, revisit under the cross-zone smoke test.

location_type_title_tokens._why_no_structural_signal: Sub-location typing happens at the same pre-fetch link-decision point as the rest of this file: no MediaWiki category/infobox is available, so the only cue is a descriptive common-noun token in the place name (Charred Outpost, Uther's Tomb, Northridge Lumber Mill). Proper-noun-only names (Andorhal, Caer Darrow, Hearthglen) carry no descriptor and fall through to 'major_location_candidate' by design; richer typing for those would require the post-fetch category signal.
location_type_title_tokens._pilot_bias_note: English descriptive nouns common to WoW zone geography. Tuned against WPL (Charred Outpost, Felstone Field, Uther's Tomb, Northridge Lumber Mill) but the vocabulary is generic zone-geography, not zone-specific. Rules are evaluated in order; first matching category wins, so destruction (ruins) outranks structure (fortress) outranks settlement (town).
location_type_title_tokens._value_maps_to: pipeline.contracts.models.LocationType; 'major_location_candidate' is the no-match default and maps to LocationType.MAJOR_LOCATION downstream.
